about_the_game:
Centuries ago, the Eldritch Mists descended without warning, shrouding the eastern continent of Etherion.
Only cursed relics and death remained. Since that day, no one dared to set foot upon its haunted soil.Now, a lone ship carries the vanguard of the United Expedition toward this forbidden land—each member driven by their own purpose, yet bound together by fate. But do curses and death truly mark an end? Or are they merely the beginning of another, unknown journey?A quest to break the curse is about to begin.

In Dominion of the Forgotten, you may embark on a solitary hero’s path or fight side by side with up to two companions. Whether you choose to brave the unknown alone or forge a team, every path offers a distinct and thrilling adventure.

Equipment Synergy: Customize Your Legendary Build

Each piece of equipment contains the power of a lost Dominion, capable of interacting with your skills to trigger additional effects. As you collect equipment, you continuously increase Dominion Power, strengthening these effects and gradually ascending the divine path through exploration. Screen-filling effects and limitless possibilities are yours to construct.

Skill Talents: Power Blossoms Through Growth

Increasing character level can be used to unlock more skill talents. Every choice reshapes your skill mechanics and forms intense synergies with Dominion effects, triggering chain reactions that make combat ever-changing.

Exploring the Unknown: Trials of the Cursed Lands

Ancient ruins along Crystal Reef Bay, the blazing furnaces of Mount Fenhuang, and the deep, shadowed ancient woods of Avendal await you with trials of varied forms. Prove your courage. The spoils of battle are not only equipment, but also forgotten truths hidden within. Each victory helps piece together lost fragments of history from the Age of Calamity.

Fighting Side by Side: Weaving Bonds Amid the Curse

Multiple heroes come together under the guidance of fate. Their vastly different abilities resonate on the battlefield, giving rise to ever-changing paths to victory. This is only the opening chapter of the legend. More companions with unique skills will soon set foot on this land, waiting to fight alongside you and jointly write your own bonds and legendary chapters.

Multiplayer Co-op: Writing the Legendary Battle Chapter Together、

The game supports up to 3-player online co-op. We have designed systems such as equipment trading, aggro mechanics, and teammate assistance. The current experience may not yet be fully polished, but we will continue refining it, and we sincerely welcome your valuable feedback and suggestions.

Join the Community / DISCORD

If you have bugs or suggestions to report, or if you want to showcase your powerful builds, you can do so in our community, Discord.

The ship has docked. The Eldritch Mists surge, the curse whispers, but your destiny has never been clearer. Set forth. After the storm passes, your legend will be forged.
